description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that implements LogNode to display log messages with formatting and in the context of an activity.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView implementation that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and throwable information, and displays them in the UI. It also supports chaining to another LogNode.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView, allowing initialization with context and optional attributes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and appends it to the LogView. Runs UI updates on the main thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to the StringBuilder if it is not null, with optional delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Adds a string as a new line to the log view.
